description: [PAID $0.01 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Diagnose another agent's discoverability: robots.txt rules against the main AI crawlers, llms.txt, A2A agent card and its mandatory fields, MCP manifest, OpenAPI with x402 payment metadata (structured price, protocols, declared 402), and optionally a live 402 challenge on a given endpoint. Returns a 0-100 score, a verdict (discoverable / partially_discoverable / invisible_to_agent_directories) and every defect with its exact fix. Deterministic, read-only, nothing is stored; private and local hosts are refused.

endpoint.description: Optional paid endpoint URL to test for a valid x402 402 challenge.

url.description: Public origin of the agent or API to diagnose, e.g. https://api.example.com

name: doctor_diagnose
